name: sMYX dividend token transfer creates unbacked profit-per-share while shrinking recorded supply
summary: The 2020 sMYX dividend token raised its profit-per-share on every transfer without any MYX inflow and, through a reversed subtraction, also shrank its recorded supply. The attacker bought a dominant sMYX position split over two contracts and alternated transfers with withdraw() calls, paying out other holders' MYX deposits as dividends.
notes: Campaign: the only txs combining sMYX share transfers with repeated withdraw() dividends since 2020 are the anchor and eight copycats within 250 blocks (four senders); earlier transfer+withdraw txs paid normal dividends. Loss is sMYX's net MYX outflow per tx, net of each buyer's own deposit.

MYX is valued at DefiLlama's price at the anchor block: the sales took about 1% of the MYX/WETH pair, so rule 12 does not apply; MYX's own transfer tax is not a market discount. sMYX is unverified; the defect is read from the trace and BlockSec's decompilation.
